title: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
author: Holly Jackson
summary: For a school project, a determined teenager decides to reinvestigate the murder of a local girl five years earlier, for which her boyfriend was blamed. The more she digs, the less safe the town feels.
readIf: you like clue-by-clue young-adult mysteries with a clever, stubborn amateur sleuth.
skipIf: you want a highly realistic police procedure, since the teen's access to evidence stretches belief.

pairings.reason: Another quick teen whodunit with a closed set of suspects and secrets that surface.
An adult detective story with an equally stubborn investigator and a re-opened death.
The classic that taught a generation to enjoy puzzles about who did it.
